  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MAY 20, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 5:00 p.m., on
  Tuesday, May 20, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis (arrived 5:04 p.m.)

  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Elaine Polachek
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:00 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Zwick and Mayor Pro Tem
  Torosis. Councilmember Snell led the assemblage in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read by Councilmember Zernitskaya.
  (LAND
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made Levine Act disclosures.
  DISCLOSURE

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items.
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY:

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:03 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and adjourned from Closed Session, with Councilmember
  Zwick absent.

  5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Manager; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator:

  1  May 20, 2025
 Docusign Envelope ID: 24679E09-B341-4073-852E-3F123FAD865A

  Mayor/Personnel Director; unrepresented employee: City Manager

  This matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  5.B. Conference with labor negotiator - Gov. Code § 54957.6: agency
  designated representatives: Interim City Manager Elaine Polachek,
  Human Resources Director Dana Brown, and Human Resources
  Manager Sarah Rebensdorf; bargaining units: Administrative Team
  Associates (ATA), AFSCME Local 4819- Management Team
  Association (MTA), California Teamsters Local 911 (IBT), Municipal
  Employees Association (MEA), Public Attorney’s Legal Support Staff
  Union (PALSSU), Public Attorney’s Union (PAU), Santa Monica Fire
  Executive Management Association (FEMA), Santa Monica Firefighters
  Local 1109 (LOCAL 1109), Police Officers Association (POA),
  Supervisory Team Association (STA) and SMART TD - International
  Association of Sheet Metal, Air, Rail, and Transportation Workers -
  Transportation Division, Local 1785 (SMART TD)

  This matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:54 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Maria Dacanay-Wisner  Lana Negrete
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor

  2  May 20, 2025
